title: MettleUp's own admin app never shows whether a gym has agreed to the terms and data agreement
what: An owner's acceptance of the terms and the data agreement is kept on the server, but only the gym's own panel reads it. The MettleUp team's admin app has no place that shows which gyms have agreed, which version, or which gyms never did.
expected: The MettleUp team can see, for each gym, whether and when it agreed to the current terms and data agreement, before opening support access or taking payment.
how_often: whenever the team checks a gym
fix_line: Show each gym's terms version and acceptance date on its admin page, and list gyms still on an old version or none.

title: A PIN or sign-in code typed in Hindi digits is silently thrown away
what: The mobile number boxes on the sign-in screens turn Hindi (and other) digits into ordinary digits, but the PIN, one-time code and WhatsApp code boxes simply delete them. A person on a keyboard that types Hindi digits sees the box stay empty and cannot tell why.
expected: Every PIN and code box takes digits in any script, as the mobile number boxes already do.
how_often: only on a keyboard that types Hindi digits
fix_line: Turn other-script digits into ordinary digits in the PIN and code boxes, using the same step the mobile boxes use.

items.reason: Area holds: staff role (owner/front desk) and its owner-only actions, trainer tick, job name, PIN, sign-out-everywhere, remove person, terms acceptance, support access window, online vs browser-only gym, offline outbox; WhatsApp verify and Forgot PIN by WhatsApp are behind a switch.

Should-read: role -> Today money tiles, AI card, shop Today card, Money tabs, exports, menu; trainer tick and removal -> trainer pages, member app trainer list, ask-a-trainer, phone sign-in role; terms -> MettleUp admin app; online mode -> screens that need the server.
Role, trainer tick, removal and online mode are read where expected; terms acceptance is read only by the panel (no HQ code or HQ function reads the table).
Member fields (field-fill.csv) are not used by this area. Own fields, one Crispy Curves query: 2 live people, 2 with mobile, 1 with a PIN, 0 with a job name, 1 owner, terms accepted once.
Mobile asked when adding a person; PIN asked after a code sign-in; terms asked once per version. Job name asked only while adding (already found).
Forgot PIN by WhatsApp and code-by-WhatsApp need the person mobile, which is required and filled 2 of 2; no feature here leans on an empty field.

Ran the mobile rule on +91 98290 12345, +91-98290-12345, 098290 12345, 919829012345, (+91) ..., 0091 ..., and Hindi digits: all give a valid 10-digit number. Name boxes have no length cut. PIN and code boxes drop Hindi digits.
